ai.title: AI product content
ai.subtitle: Prepare, review and import content for each shop.
ai.settingsDescription: Content rules, category profiles, automation and processing history.
ai.setupHelp: OpenAI processing is not enabled yet. You can prepare rules after unlocking AI settings.
ai.setupInstructions: Create a separate API project and project key in OpenAI Platform. Your server administrator adds it to /opt/inventory-hub/ai-content.env, sets the Hub access token, enables AI and restarts the API as described in docs/ai-content.md.
ai.independentAccount: The API project can belong to another account. This connection does not use a ChatGPT subscription or ChatGPT project. API billing is separate.
ai.unlockHelp: Use the Hub access token configured by your server administrator. Do not enter an OpenAI API key here.
ai.legacyCategoryRulesHelp: These rules were preserved from earlier versions. You can edit or remove them; manage standard instructions and parameters in the profile under Categories.
ai.rulesHelp: Rules apply in order: common → supplier → brand → category → shop → product → this preparation. Empty settings inherit. Saving creates a draft; publishing applies it to new jobs.
ai.restoreHelp: Load, compare and republish an earlier version. Existing jobs retain their original rules.
ai.officialDomains: Preferred official websites (optional, comma separated; AI can discover others)
ai.parametersHelp: AI can fill only the listed parameters. Missing required evidence blocks import. Variant parameters must match the existing feed choice axes.
ai.allowedValues: Allowed values separated by | (empty = free value)
ai.publishDraftHelp: First enter a reason for the change and save a draft. You can then publish it for new jobs.
ai.proposalHelp: AI uses the published profile. It proposes instructions and optionally the category parameter registry. Proposals are never published automatically.
ai.proposalPlaceholder: What should be added or clarified?
ai.acceptProposal: Save proposal as a rule draft
ai.estimateHelp: This estimate is not an invoice or a guaranteed price. The allowance counts towards the Hub budget and is replaced by recorded usage after the response.
ai.activeAfterImport: Product will be active after import
ai.hiddenAfterImport: Product will remain hidden after import
ai.reselectPartial: Select the new variants in the catalog and prepare a separate job. Content is tied to the exact variant selection.
ai.prepareHelp: Only selected products and variants are included. AI edits the shared family content; the existing importer manages prices and identity. Each shop receives its own content and result.
ai.researchFeed: Feed only – quick processing without additional research
ai.fallbackCategory: Category when the profile has no mapping
ai.mappingPriority: Category profile mapping takes precedence over this fallback category. Switches here apply only to this preparation.
ai.automaticNotice: Processing follows the selected profiles. Disabling the estimate skips the cost pause; disabling approval and confirmation enables automatic import. Technical errors always stop import.
ai.jobPersistence: Jobs persist on the server. Removing from the list archives them; history and costs remain.
ai.noJobs: No jobs yet. Select products in a supplier catalog.

openingStock.title: Opening stock
openingStock.subtitle: Record a verified physical count and its acquisition costs.
openingStock.scope: This operation writes physical stock to the Hub. Use it only for items with no existing balance or movements in the selected warehouse. Do not import stock already recorded through receiving.
openingStock.tokenHelp: Use the same token as for AI content and order audit. It stays in memory only until page reload or locking.
openingStock.recoveryHelp: After a lost connection or page reload, check the original batch first. Checking only reads its stored state and does not post stock.
openingStock.csvHelp: UTF-8 CSV with columns sku;quantity;unit_cost;unit. Quantity must be a positive whole number and unit must be ks (pieces). Unit acquisition cost is EUR excluding VAT; use a decimal point. A missing price is an error; an explicit zero price needs review.
openingStock.limits: Up to {{rows}} items, file up to 1 MB.
openingStock.moreIssues: {{count}} more messages. Correct the source and create a new preview.
openingStock.name: Product
openingStock.completedHelp: Stock movements are stored. Opening this batch again will not increase stock again.
openingStock.expired: The preview has expired. Prepare a new preview and review the source again.
openingStock.uncertain: The posting result could not be confirmed. This batch may already be posted. Check its stored state first; do not create another batch for the same stock.
openingStock.confirmPhysical: I confirm the physically counted quantities, correct warehouse and acquisition costs in EUR excluding VAT shown in this preview.
openingStock.confirmReceipts: I reconciled receipts and invoices; I will not post this stock again from an unfinished receiving session.

errors.opening_invalid_request: Check the required fields, time and confirmations.

orderStock.title: Orders and stock
orderStock.subtitle: Controlled reservations, release and stock issue from the current order.
orderStock.scope: You explicitly run each operation after reviewing its preview. This page does not send stock to shops or process orders automatically.
orderStock.tokenHelp: Use the same token as for order audit. It stays in memory, never in URLs or browser storage.
orderStock.activeSince: Active since {{at}} · policy revision {{revision}}. The warehouse and start time are fixed.
orderStock.cutoverHelp: The first save starts tracking from the current time. Older orders are not posted retrospectively. Table suggestions are not applied automatically; choose an operation for every status.
orderStock.configConfirm: I confirm the correct warehouse, verified physical opening stock and selected operations for all order statuses.
orderStock.configUncertain: The rule save could not be confirmed. Load current settings before submitting again.
orderStock.saveBeforePreview: Save changed rules or reload stored settings before creating a preview.
orderStock.previewHelp: The order is loaded directly from the shop. Confirmation rechecks its content, rules and stock quantities.
orderStock.planErrors: The operation needs correction or review
orderStock.noPartialIssue: Stock issue must cover every stocked line. After issue, contents are locked; changes require an official return, claim or refused delivery.
orderStock.excludedHelp: These manual or non-stock lines do not create reservations or stock movements.
orderStock.completedHelp: Opening this preview again does not create another stock movement.
orderStock.applyUncertain: The result could not be confirmed. The operation may already be complete. Check its stored state before another attempt.
orderStock.expired: The preview has expired. Load the order and prepare a new preview.
orderStock.blocked: The preview contains blocking errors. The operation cannot be confirmed.
orderStock.applyConfirm: I reviewed the order, warehouse, quantities and displayed changes. I confirm this operation.
orderStock.physicalConfirm: I confirm the physical handover or dispatch of all stocked lines in this order.

errors.request_failed: The operation could not be completed. After a lost connection, check its stored state first.
errors.hub_access_required: Enter a valid Hub access token.
errors.hub_access_not_configured: The Hub access token is not configured.
errors.preview_shop_mismatch: The preview belongs to another shop. Select the correct shop.
errors.order_stock_preview_expired: The preview has expired. Prepare a new preview.
errors.order_stock_shop_not_found: The shop was not found or is inactive.
errors.order_stock_not_configured: Configure and confirm this shop’s processing rules first.
errors.order_stock_warehouse_unavailable: The selected warehouse is unavailable or inactive.
errors.order_stock_statuses_changed: Shop statuses changed. Load current settings and confirm the rules again.
errors.order_stock_invalid_status_actions: An operation does not match its status. Choose review or the allowed operation for that status.
errors.order_stock_return_requires_review: A return, claim or refused delivery requires its own official process. This operation does not restore stock.
errors.order_stock_warehouse_fixed: The warehouse cannot be changed through this form after activation.
errors.order_stock_before_cutover: The order predates stock tracking activation and will not be posted retrospectively.
errors.order_stock_source_date_invalid: Order timestamps are invalid. Check the source data.
errors.order_stock_unknown_status: The order status is absent from the loaded status list. Reload settings.
errors.order_stock_status_requires_review: This status requires review; no stock operation will run.
errors.order_stock_preview_not_found: Preview not found. Check its ID or load recent previews.
errors.order_stock_request_changed: This ID belongs to another request. Check the original preview or prepare a new one.
errors.order_stock_issued_locked: The order has already been issued and is locked. Changes require an official return, claim or refused delivery.
errors.order_stock_preview_changed: The confirmation does not match the stored preview. Check its stored state.
errors.order_stock_preview_blocked: The preview contains blocking errors. Correct them and prepare a new preview.
errors.order_stock_physical_confirmation_requir: Issue requires confirmation of physical handover or dispatch.
errors.order_stock_source_changed: The order changed after preview. Check the stored state and prepare a new preview.
errors.order_stock_policy_changed: Rules changed after preview. Load current settings and prepare a new preview.
errors.order_stock_revision_changed: Another operation processed this order. Check its stored state and prepare a new preview.
errors.order_stock_action_invalid: This stock operation is not allowed. Reload settings and preview.
errors.order_stock_invalid_order: The order has an invalid identity or creation time. Check the source data.
errors.order_stock_invariant: Recorded reservations or stock values are inconsistent. Administrator review is required before processing.
errors.order_stock_order_identity_conflict: The order number and identity conflict. Check the order before further processing.
errors.order_stock_plan_blocked: The operation is blocked. Correct the lines or stock and prepare a new preview.
errors.order_stock_preview_stale: Stock or reservations changed after preview. Check the stored state and prepare a new preview.
errors.order_stock_unmanaged_order: This existing order is outside the new stock workflow and will not be adopted retrospectively.
errors.order_stock_warehouse_changed: The order belongs to another warehouse. Review the configuration.
errors.order_stock_warehouse_missing: The order warehouse was not found.
errors.order_stock_inactive_product: The product is inactive in the Hub. Review its state first.
errors.order_stock_insufficient_stock: Stock is insufficient for the full issue. Partial issue is not allowed.
errors.order_stock_invalid_line_key: The line has no unique valid identity. Check the order.
errors.order_stock_line_identity: The line has no unambiguous stock identity. Correct its product identity; a name alone is insufficient.
errors.order_stock_quantity_unsupported: Quantity must be a positive whole number within the allowed range.
errors.order_stock_unit_unsupported: Only whole pieces with unit ks are supported. Metres or packs are not converted automatically.
errors.order_stock_invalid_order_number: Enter a valid exact order number.
errors.order_stock_invalid_response: The shop returned incomplete or invalid data. The operation was not performed.
errors.order_stock_rate_limited: The shop API limit was reached. Retry reading later; do not repeat an operation without checking.
errors.order_stock_source_missing: No active order with this number was found in the shop.
errors.order_stock_source_unavailable: The order or statuses could not be loaded from the shop. Try reading again later.
errors.order_stock_upgates_access: The shop rejected API access. Check its configuration.

orderStock.posHelp: A paid and completed cash-register sale in the base received status with reservations enabled is proposed for issue. Payment alone never triggers issue of a web order.
orderStock.moreErrors: {{count}} more errors. Correct the source and prepare a new preview.
